# CamryHub repository instructions

Read and follow the root AGENTS.md before changing files; it is the canonical project configuration.
Read .ai/skills/README.md and open only the workflow files relevant to the task.
Keep visitors account-free and current unprotected admin controls read-only/mock-only; never expose unauthenticated privileged writes.
Follow installed package versions, TypeScript strict typing, Server Components by default, shared Zod schemas, and /lib/data accessors.
Use Tailwind and existing shadcn-compatible UI. Ask before heavy dependencies, auth, or large refactors.
Report scoped diffs and actual checks; do not claim unperformed deployment/browser/database checks.
